consecutive_prospective_bars_captured_va.reading: every expected closed hour is in the slice and the lane evaluated the most recent ones; none produced a proposal. Provenance is per bar in CAPTURE_INTEGRITY.capture_provenance: only bars the ledger first saw within one hour of their close count as received at close

do_broker_net_risk_equity_and_reconcilia.reading: yes: every ClosedTrade satisfies pnl = reference gross - execution cost - both commissions, the broker equity is 10 000 + realised + unrealised, and RiskManager.equity is marked to that same figure before every decision

how_many_are_missing_and_why.why: none in the frozen window: the append-only collector's resumable fetch backfilled every closed hour since the freeze. Hours before the freeze are not expected. The collector is manual, so a future hour with no run is MISSING_NO_COLLECTOR and never a quiet market.

what_still_blocks_continuous_prospective: no scheduler is authorized: a Windows scheduled task needs administrator privileges, which this package did not attempt
the collector is manual, so an hour nobody runs it is MISSING_NO_COLLECTOR
no strategy is admitted in config/strategy_admission.json, so the runtime paper path has nothing to execute; the experimental lane is a research lane that bypasses admission by design
the host volume is 99% full; the collector's own footprint is ~9.6 KB/h, so disk is no longer the reason, but the volume is not healthy

which_paper_trades_net_risk_actually_all.reading: fills are 1x 146, 2x 146, 3x 121. Cost only removes a fill where a periodic loss rule binds, so 1x and 2x can share a count; unlike the pre-017F replay, a weekly veto no longer accumulates for the whole run.

git.note: the code under these numbers is the working tree at this head; the evidence is committed after it, so this hash names the code commit, not the evidence commit

limitations: prospective bars: 6 were first recorded within one hour of their close and 18 were recovered later by the append-only collector; the honest claim is post-freeze data, and only the first class is live capture
the replay has no order book and no data-age clock, so spread and latency blocks are enforced on the runtime entrypoint and declared NOT_MEASURED for the bar replay
the broker charges half the spread and slippage per side; a stop filled at its level is still optimistic for a gap through it
2x/3x are genuine re-runs of the lane with the cost multiplier applied inside the book; they are not the same fills repriced, because the extra cost changes which entries pass risk
